name: CM4AI U2OS Release: IF Image Downloader
description: Immunofluorescence (IF) images downloaded from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) version 23 for U2OS cell lines. Images were obtained using the cellmaps_imagedownloader tool, which retrieves IF microscopy images for genes of interest. Each image captures protein localization patterns via antibody staining with blue (nucleus/DAPI), red (microtubules), and green (target protein) channels. This dataset covers approximately 10,825 unique gene targets.

rai:dataLimitations: This is an interim release. Images are sourced from the Human Protein Atlas and represent antibody-based protein localization in U2OS cells only. Results may not generalize to other cell types or staining conditions. Requires domain expertise for meaningful analysis.
rai:dataBiases: Data in this release was derived from a single cell line (U2OS) and does not represent all biological variants which may be seen in the population at large. Antibody specificity and staining quality vary across targets.
rai:dataUseCases: AI-ready datasets to support research in functional genomics, AI/machine learning model training, protein localization prediction, cellular process analysis, and image embedding generation for the Cell Maps pipeline.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Release-level RO-Crate is versioned and updated alongside the CM4AI pipeline sub-crates through the end of the project (November 2026). Long-term preservation in https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/, supported by committed institutional funds.
rai:dataCollection: Images were downloaded from the Human Protein Atlas (https://www.proteinatlas.org/) version 23 using the cellmaps_imagedownloader tool.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Protein-protein interaction (BioPlex AP-MS) and protein localization (HPA IF imaging) interrogate protein sets that only partially overlap; ~5,147 of the proteins detectable in U2OS are represented in both modalities, and the remainder appear in only one of the two input sources.
completeness: Protein-protein interaction (BioPlex AP-MS) and protein localization (HPA IF imaging) data interrogate sets of proteins which incompletely overlap. Release covers U2OS only.
